title: 第1章 请与我签订契约第2章 高端的猎人
slug: 异世界开局俘虏女骑士
lines: 【叮！漫游者先生，请停止无谓的拖延，尽快与我签订契约完成任务！】
“不可能！你他妈快把老子送回去！”
老旧的农舍内，一名眼瞳漆黑的青年神色难看地躲在其中，与脑海里的声音激情对骂着。
青年五官秀气透着阳光，头上包着一根白色的毛巾，腰间挂着一把朴素的长剑。
他叫齐格飞，姓齐，名格飞。虽然名字很奇怪，但他是个纯正的汉人，生于地球长于华夏。
七天前他一觉醒来就发现自己来到这个陌生的世界，而后……
【叮！漫游者齐格飞，欢迎来到奇兰大陆，我是您的管制史官，您可以称呼我为夏侬。】
【精灵、矮人、兽人、巨龙、魔族，在这个种族混杂的剑与魔法的幻想世界，我会帮助您生存、成长。】
【请与我签订契约、修正历史，尽情享受异世界漫游之旅吧。】
齐格飞记得很清楚，这家伙在说“修正历史”这四个字的时候声音轻地几乎听不见，像极了黑心企业合同上用特小字体标注的免责声明。
齐格飞哪能上这种当啊！
“你听着！我对异世界穿越不感兴趣，只想做一个平凡的上班族，我家里还有个十四岁的妹妹要养，你最好赶紧把我送回去！赶紧！”
【当然可以，签订契约完成任务，我就会将您送回现实。】
“你特么！”
齐格飞气的龇牙咧嘴。
如果是平常，他大可以继续摆烂和夏侬比耐性，可现在不行。
“你！给我出来！双手抱头不许反抗！”
“那边的给我蹲下！老子让你蹲下听不懂吗！”
“把所有的粮食都交出来！”
嘈杂声从屋外传进来，那些家伙的声音越来越近了！
齐格飞从门缝中朝外看去，
几个戴着圆盔士兵正手举长矛挨家挨户抓捕村民、搜刮财物，马上就要轮到自己躲藏的这间破农舍了！
他脸色阴沉，语气又气又急：“该死的，快点送我回去！”
【您就打算眼睁睁地看着这座村庄被洗劫吗？】
“啧，和我有什么关系！我只是个穿越者。”
【可您继承了这个世界齐格飞的记忆，那些并不是虚假的。】
齐格飞听得眼皮直跳。
是的，他似乎是占据了这个世界齐格飞的身体，还继承了他的记忆。
记忆里他是个弃婴，长着黑头发黑眼睛还是黄皮肤。
在奇兰大陆上，拥有这种基因特征的只有梅兰家族。一个诞生了上百位勇者，从遥远的过去便在魔王的窥伺中守护着人类的传奇家族。
齐格飞自然而然地被当成了未来的勇者，受尽村民们的敬仰。
二十年来，村里的叔叔婶婶们把他当成自己的孩子一般，照顾的无微不至。孩子们也将他当成老大，对他荒谬大胆的冒险计划言听计从。
这些回忆都像是真实发生过的一般历历在目，熟悉而又陌生。
“那……那都是你给我灌输的虚假记忆！”
content_en:
【bite! Mr. Wanderer, please stop the unnecessary delay and sign a contract with me as soon as possible to complete the mission! 】
"Impossible! Send me back the fuck quickly!"
In the old farmhouse, a young man with dark eyes was hiding in it with an ugly expression, arguing passionately with the voice in his head.
The young man's facial features are delicate and sunny, with a white towel wrapped on his head and a simple long sword hanging on his waist.
His name is Siegfried, his surname is Qi and his first name is Gefei. Although his name is strange, he is a pure Han Chinese, born on earth and raised in China.
Seven days ago, when he woke up, he found himself in this strange world, and then...
[Ding! Siegfried the Wanderer, welcome to the continent of Chilan. I am your regulatory historian. You can call me Shannon. 】
[Elves, dwarves, orcs, dragons, demons, in this fantasy world of swords and magic where races are mixed, I will help you survive and grow. 】
[Please sign a contract with me, correct history, and enjoy your journey to another world. 】
Siegfried remembered clearly that when this guy said the words "correct history", his voice was so soft that it was almost inaudible. It was very much like the disclaimer marked in extremely small fonts on the contract of a black-hearted enterprise.
How could Siegfried be fooled like this!
"Listen! I'm not interested in traveling to another world. I just want to be an ordinary office worker. I have a fourteen-year-old sister to raise at home. You'd better send me back as soon as possible! Hurry!"
[Of course, sign the contract and complete the task, and I will send you back to reality. 】
"What the hell!"
Siegfried bared his teeth angrily.
If it was normal, he could continue to show off his patience with Shannon, but not now.
"You! Come out! Hold your head with your hands and don't resist!"
"Squat down over there! I told you to squat down, don't you understand?"
"Hand over all the food!"
Noise came from outside the house, and the voices of those guys were getting closer and closer!
Siegfried looked out from the crack in the door.
A few soldiers wearing round helmets were going from house to house with spears in hand to arrest villagers and search for their property. It was about to be their turn to hide in the dilapidated farmhouse!
His face was gloomy and his tone was angry and urgent: "Damn it, send me back quickly!"
[Are you just going to watch this village being looted? 】
"Tsk, what does it have to do with me! I'm just a time traveler."
[But you inherited the memories of Siegfried in this world, and those are not false. 】
Siegfried's eyelids jumped as he heard this.
Yes, he seems to have taken over Siegfried's body in this world and inherited his memories.
In my memory, he was an abandoned baby with black hair, black eyes, and yellow skin.
On the Qilan continent, only the Meilan family possesses this genetic trait. A legendary family that gave birth to hundreds of brave men and has been protecting mankind from the devil's spying since the distant past.
Siegfried was naturally regarded as the future hero and was admired by the villagers.
For twenty years, the uncles and aunts in the village treated him as their own child and took good care of him. The children also regard him as their boss and obey his absurd and daring adventure plans.
These memories are as vivid as if they really happened, familiar yet strange.
"That...those are all false memories you instilled in me!"
